answer_2.quote: We evaluate different approaches and systems using classical sentence- and document-level evaluation metrics. About sentence-level metrics, we employ the commonly-used sacreBLEU and TER. Additionally, we utilize COMET, which leverages pretrained language models to achieve high correlations with human quality judgments. About document-level metrics, we report document-level sacreBLEU (d-BLEU). We utilized two targeted metrics, namely, CTT and AZPT

answer_3.quote: For ChatGPT, we query them with the prompt P4 in Table to obtain responses and correspondent explanations for each instance.

answer_4.quote: To thoroughly validate our conclusions, we also conduct a human evaluation (see Section Limitation.). We employed two professional evaluators for our study.
answer_4.guideline: We establish two sets of evaluation criteria: 1) general quality, covering aspects such as fluency and adequacy; 2) discourse-aware quality, including factors such as consistency, word choice, and anaphora.
